rows.item: Shenzhou-17 return capsule (神舟十七号返回舱), heat-scorched flown capsule
rows.notes: Open to the public since 2026-08-04, announced as long-term display; page read 2026-11-09. Museum page itself not found.

rows.item: Chang'e-6 return capsule and parachute (嫦娥六号返回舱及降落伞)
rows.notes: TEMPORARY: exhibition 2026-10-02 to 2026-11-22 (Xinhua). hk01 article says the parachute is real and the lander is a 1:2 model; capsule itself named only in Xinhua.

rows.item: Feitian extravehicular spacesuit (飞天舱外航天服)
rows.notes: TEMPORARY to 2026-11-22. Listed as 实物 but source does not say whether flown, backup or training unit.

rows.item: Long March 3B booster engine wreckage (长征三号乙运载火箭发动机残骸)
rows.notes: TEMPORARY to 2026-11-22. Recovered debris of a flown rocket.
Source lists 舱内航天服 on display at the new museum (opened 2022-11-16) without saying flown, backup or training; matched to Shenzhou IVA by role.

rows.item: Long March 2F launch escape tower, about 8 m (长征二号F运载火箭逃逸塔实物)
rows.notes: Real tower per source; not stated whether flown or ground-test unit. A component, not the whole rocket.

rows.item: Chang'e-6 sampling/drilling subsystem (嫦娥六号探测器钻采子系统实物)
rows.notes: Listed as 实物 among new exhibits (Dec 2024); HIT built the subsystem; whether flight spare or engineering unit is not stated. Secondary source, museum page not read.
